terminal_name: Delimara Onshore Natural Gas Terminal (gem.wiki-only, no CSV row)
issue: Discovery SOP 4.0b gem.wiki coverage cross-check found a gem.wiki page, 'Delimara Onshore Natural Gas Terminal', with NO matching export-CSV row for Malta (Malta's only CSV row is Delimara FSRU, T100000130490). Independent verification (Malta Energy & Water Agency public consultation, government MECP/MEW consultation pages, ERA project record PA08757-17, EU PCI list, VDP Srl) confirms this is the receiving terminal STATION for the Malta-Italy Gas Pipeline (EU PCI 5.19 / Melita TransGas), a 159 km subsea+onshore PIPELINE interconnector from Gela, Sicily to the Delimara peninsula -- explicitly designed, per the project's own public materials, to 'eliminate the need for liquefaction, shipping and re-gasification as in the case with LNG.' No marine LNG crosses a border by ship at this site. FAILS the scope gate (pipeline-fed gas receiving station, not a marine LNG terminal) -- resolved as out of scope BEFORE staging, per the hard rule against stage-with-doubt.
suggested_action: No action -- correctly out of scope for the LNG Terminals tracker (it is a natural-gas pipeline interconnector receiving station, not an LNG facility; belongs to gas-pipeline infrastructure tracking if tracked at all, not GGIT LNG terminals).

issue: Ring D sweep found a Nationalist Party (opposition) 2026 general-election manifesto proposal (lovinmalta.com) to relocate the existing operating Delimara FSRU tanker further offshore to free up coastline. This is a political-party policy proposal, not a sponsor-backed project -- fails both the 'sponsor identified' and 'concrete step taken' threshold elements (Discovery SOP 3). Not a new terminal, and not monitor-list-worthy as it proposes modifying an existing terminal rather than adding one.
suggested_action: No action -- watch for a formal government/sponsor-backed proposal (not a party manifesto item) in future sweeps.
